## Checklist

- [ ] Pulled `main` and re-imported before writing
- [ ] Each card is one fact, with the front phrased as a question
- [ ] Each card has a `domain::` and a `type::` tag valid for that deck
- [ ] I can explain every card without looking it up
- [ ] `python tools/lint_cards.py` passes
- [ ] `git diff` shows only my cards, no deck-option or note-type churn
